name: @eidolonmc/wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for Eidolon Minecraft skin renderer

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:dev: wasm-pack build --dev --target bundler --out-dir pkg && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/web && rm -f pkg/web/.gitignore
